title: Designing solar panels for realistic end-of-life scenarios - Nature Reviews Materials
byline: Niu; Bo; Gao; Ruitong; Xu; Zhenming; Ruan; Jujun
html:
The rapid growth of photovoltaics is generating vast waste streams, a portion of which flows to regions where recycling is unregulated. Solar panel design criteria do not account for these end-of-life realities, creating global asymmetry in environmental burdens. This Comment proposes research directions beyond material substitution to address these design gaps.
